lastAnalysis.notes:
s2 - toll king

- cinderford east gate, rain. toll king's collectors (capt Vesk) want 100g "bridge-breaker's tax" or a hostage
- brakka tied his own wrists w/ rope and offered to go, vesk backed off a bit
- wick stole the writ right off her glove (lol) - it just says "bring the one who fed the Silent One", no gold at all. he also accused the bell lady of working w/ vesk, she laughed at him
- luz tried the blessing token thing, got laughed at. later held up her symbol in front of the crowd and made it too public for vesk to draw
- maren NAT 20 persuasion, talked vesk down, no fight at the gate
- tovin took the rag-market woman's deal for real this time - gave her a year of his dreams. she told him the Silent One is a drowned god under the toll-fort and the toll king feeds it people who surrender
- brakka tried to get in front of tovin, slipped on the cobbles

- greyhook toll-fort: toll king + 4 drowned thralls out of the pool, hostage guard (Oren) tied up by the water
- brakka held the stone lip so they came one at a time, hacked one down
- maren entangle only got 1 of 4. then Thorn Lash on the one going for the wagon, pinned it, wick finished it off
- toll king drowned maren's lungs w/ pool water, she went down to half. luz healing word'd her
- wick cut Oren loose and hid him behind the wagon. cut steve loose to charge a thrall, steve just ran away
- tovin nat20 eldritch blast for 3 dmg 💀. then he told everyone the guard was "his coin", creepy
- wick yelled at vesk until she switched sides, collectors killed the other 2 thralls
- luz sanctuary on Oren (toll king shrugged it off), sacred flame, guiding bolt missed
- end: toll king offered tovin his crown. brakka lassoed him, maren thorn-whipped him out of the pool, wick threw a dagger through his hand
- tovin took the crown and made his patron EAT the silent one?? pool drained. toll king gave up, vesk arrested him. tovin kept the crown

- 2 days at the fort
- brakka fixed the gate, stood watch outside maren's room. couldn't find steve
- maren found steve in an orchard. her turnips in the pool silt rotted. bread w/ Oren was amazing, he told us the toll king fed 31 people to the pool. she got vesk to pay for fixing the shrine
- luz read all 31 names at the shrine, didn't work (yet). she's watching tovin
- wick found a hidden ledger page -> "the Lantern House in Varrow". also pocketed 30g. licked the shrine
- tovin got caught stealing old coins by vesk. crown just hums, toll king won't talk to him

next time: varrow / lantern house. who's bringing snacks. also can maren's thorn lash crit?? ask at start

entry.name: Daggerdance: Thrown Weapon Expertise

mechanics.effect: Gain proficiency in throwing daggers. When you hit a creature with a thrown dagger, you can use your bonus action to retrieve it if it is within 5 feet of you. entry.name: Hexblade: The Hollowing

mechanics.effect: When you kill a creature that has surrendered or is incapacitated, you gain advantage on your next saving throw against a mental effect. However, you suffer a -2 penalty to all Persuasion and Deception checks until you complete a long rest, representing a growing detachment from mercy and social nuance.

malignance.drawback: Penalty to social skills and increased risk of being perceived as a threat by neutral factions.

lineage.rationale: The character explicitly killed a surrendering goblin, indicating a willingness to inflict harm beyond necessity, which aligns with the 'cruelty' vice.

mechanics.effect: Make a spell attack against one creature within 60 feet. On a hit, deal 2d8 fire damage. If the target is a Large or larger creature, they must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be Frightened until the end of their next turn.

lineage.rationale: Demonstrated ability to cast Eldritch Blast and use fire to kill a troll, suggesting a potent elemental magical affinity.

entry.name: Patron: Dream Weaver's Bargain

mechanics.effect: You can sacrifice 1d4 hours of your own sleep (reducing your maximum Hit Points by 1d4 until you rest) to grant one ally within 30 feet advantage on their next saving throw or ability check. This represents the transfer of mental fortitude or insight drawn from your own subconscious.

lineage.rationale: The character explicitly traded a year of dreams to a market woman, indicating a unique magical ability to manipulate or sacrifice dream states for benefit.

lastAnalysis.notes:
s2 - toll king

- cinderford east gate, rain. toll king's collectors (capt Vesk) want 100g "bridge-breaker's tax" or a hostage
- brakka tied his own wrists w/ rope and offered to go, vesk backed off a bit
- wick stole the writ right off her glove (lol) - it just says "bring the one who fed the Silent One", no gold at all. he also accused the bell lady of working w/ vesk, she laughed at him
- luz tried the blessing token thing, got laughed at. later held up her symbol in front of the crowd and made it too public for vesk to draw
- maren NAT 20 persuasion, talked vesk down, no fight at the gate
- tovin took the rag-market woman's deal for real this time - gave her a year of his dreams. she told him the Silent One is a drowned god under the toll-fort and the toll king feeds it people who surrender
- brakka tried to get in front of tovin, slipped on the cobbles

- greyhook toll-fort: toll king + 4 drowned thralls out of the pool, hostage guard (Oren) tied up by the water
- brakka held the stone lip so they came one at a time, hacked one down
- maren entangle only got 1 of 4. then Thorn Lash on the one going for the wagon, pinned it, wick finished it off
- toll king drowned maren's lungs w/ pool water, she went down to half. luz healing word'd her
- wick cut Oren loose and hid him behind the wagon. cut steve loose to charge a thrall, steve just ran away
- tovin nat20 eldritch blast for 3 dmg 💀. then he told everyone the guard was "his coin", creepy
- wick yelled at vesk until she switched sides, collectors killed the other 2 thralls
- luz sanctuary on Oren (toll king shrugged it off), sacred flame, guiding bolt missed
- end: toll king offered tovin his crown. brakka lassoed him, maren thorn-whipped him out of the pool, wick threw a dagger through his hand
- tovin took the crown and made his patron EAT the silent one?? pool drained. toll king gave up, vesk arrested him. tovin kept the crown

- 2 days at the fort
- brakka fixed the gate, stood watch outside maren's room. couldn't find steve
- maren found steve in an orchard. her turnips in the pool silt rotted. bread w/ Oren was amazing, he told us the toll king fed 31 people to the pool. she got vesk to pay for fixing the shrine
- luz read all 31 names at the shrine, didn't work (yet). she's watching tovin
- wick found a hidden ledger page -> "the Lantern House in Varrow". also pocketed 30g. licked the shrine
- tovin got caught stealing old coins by vesk. crown just hums, toll king won't talk to him

next time: varrow / lantern house. who's bringing snacks. also can maren's thorn lash crit?? ask at start

entry.name: Sanctuary: Mending Light

mechanics.effect: When you cast a healing spell on an ally, you may use your reaction to grant that ally 5 temporary hit points. This represents the lingering divine grace that stabilizes the target immediately after the spell takes effect.

lineage.rationale: Luz has repeatedly demonstrated the ability to restore allies to full health and protect them from further harm, showing a consistent pattern of divine support and medical stabilization.

entry.name: Sanctuary: Public Edict

mechanics.effect: As an action, you hold up your holy symbol and make a Persuasion or Intimidation check against one hostile creature within 30 feet. On a success, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. On a success, it is not Frightened but is Disadvantaged on its next attack roll against you or your allies.

lineage.rationale: Luz successfully used her holy symbol in a public setting to deter a hostile action, demonstrating an ability to leverage divine authority and social pressure to de-escalate conflicts.
